node.title: XR light-profile eliminant nonvanishing
node.statement: For every budget-meeting light-triangle profile not already paid or boundary, the normal-form matrix from xr_triangle_eliminant_form has at least one maximal minor that is a nonzero polynomial in the profile coordinates. This follows once the certificate semantics are fixed and every unpaid light profile is covered by a concrete nonzero minor/specialization certificate.
node.attack_surface: assembled from xr_minor_specialization_certificate_semantics plus xr_profile_minor_certificate_coverage; the latter is the remaining uniform certificate-production problem
node.falsifier: a budget-meeting unpaid light profile for which no admissible nonzero maximal-minor specialization exists
